hypothesis: Growth in on-chain activity (active addresses, transaction count) over the prior 7 and 30 days carries POSITIVE directional information about forward returns at the longer horizons (72h, 168h); hash-rate growth and fee growth weaker/ambiguous; last difficulty adjustment unspecified.
acceptance_criterion: PRE-REGISTERED before running. Direction: Spearman(feature, return_H) block-bootstrap 95% interval excludes zero with the same sign in BOTH exploration and validation. Magnitude: same, plus |rho| >= 0.10 both periods.

availability_check.blockchain_info_charts: daily points from 2009 (6,433-6,459 per series) via sampled=false; timestamp = 00:00 UTC of the day covered. Used: hash-rate, n-transactions, n-unique-addresses, transaction-fees-usd.
availability_check.point_in_time_rule: day D known from D+1 06:00 UTC (tested); last known value persists; staleness recorded
availability_check.difficulty_adjustments: 466 adjustments with block timestamps (mempool.space); known from the block time (tested)

target.definition: signed forward return (direction) and absolute forward return (magnitude)
target.outcome: close of candle opening at as_of+H

point_in_time: 4 tests in tests/test_onchain_features.py pass (visibility before/after D+1 06:00; difficulty block time; garbled-future)

metrics.direction_pattern: addr_chg_7d and txcount_chg_7d: POSITIVE in exploration with intervals excluding zero at 6-72h (addr 24h +0.039 [+0.008, +0.071]; 72h +0.049 [+0.010, +0.096]) but NEGATIVE in validation (-0.042, -0.078). Hash rate, fees, 30-day changes, difficulty: nothing in either period.
metrics.magnitude: only onchain_staleness_h at 6h: -0.043 / -0.075 (consistent, below floor). Staleness = hours since 06:00 UTC, i.e. time of day: |returns| are larger in the hours after the daily value is fresh (US session). Not an on-chain effect.
metrics.redundancy: addr_chg_7d ~ txcount_chg_7d high (activity measures move together)

results: NO PASS. Activity growth (addresses, transactions) leans the expected way in 2017-2023 and the opposite way in 2024-2025 -- the same pattern as long-horizon trend (E004): a relationship that held in the older period did not survive the recent one. Hash rate, fees and difficulty carry nothing. Side-observation: a time-of-day effect on move SIZE exists (via the staleness feature); it belongs to the uncertainty model, not to on-chain data.
consistent_across_time: No (sign flip between periods for the only candidates).
leakage_check: visibility rules tested; small effect sizes; no suspicious values
affected_design: No feature adopted. Note for Phase 11: consider hour-of-day (UTC) as an input to the move-size / uncertainty model, with its own pre-registered test.
notes: Daily-resolution features repeated over 24 hourly rows; block bootstrap (>= 48h) accounts for the dependence.
